msg.fileProtocol:
The page is open directly from disk, so the browser blocks reading the files
(file:// security rule).

Either serve the folder over HTTP, then reload:

    python3 -m http.server 8000   # from the folder containing index.html
    open http://localhost:8000/

or switch Source to “Local folder (offline)” and pick the folder directly.
